mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate rise exceeding 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger recessionary fears, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 for 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and rising consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) indicate housing sector contraction amid inflationary pressures, reducing consumer confidence and equity valuations for negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST declines and CPIAUCSL rises, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) combined with high business investment (RSAFS) signals manufacturing sector weakness amid elevated capital spending, reducing earnings growth expectations for negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
regime_hint: industrial slowdown with high business investment
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO declines and RSAFS exceeds 400,000, or interaction term Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% signals persistent inflation that may accelerate monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 2.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 for 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over 6 months indicates strengthening labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases for 6 consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In high consumer spending regimes (RSAFS > 450,000), declining housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening demand for housing, reducing overall consumer spending and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS > 450000 and HOUST declines, or regime-triggered signal Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates broad economic contraction, reducing corporate earnings growth expectations for negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO declines and UNRATE rises, or interaction term Rank IC remains below 0.03.
